reason: I already pay Rentlio and my agency to talk to guests, and Booking and Airbnb send the check-in messages for free. Another €35 a month plus €150 for a QR code that answers Wi-Fi questions is one more subscription I don't need for one villa.
objection: It duplicates what my channel manager and agency already do. If the AI tells a guest paying €4,000 a week something wrong about the pool or check-in, it's my reviews that suffer, and I'm often not even in the country to fix it.
would_change_my_mind: If it plugged straight into Rentlio so I could drop part of what the agency charges me, and it actually saved me money instead of adding a cost.
